capabilities: chat with ACP-compatible AI agents inside Obsidian views
review agent file edits in a side-by-side diff before approving
approve or deny terminal commands requested by agents
save agent conversations as timestamped markdown files
trigger agents from frontmatter and expose Obsidian commands via an MCP server
extras: Desktop only (requires Node.js child processes); not yet in the Community Plugins store. README carries a security warning that agents can execute arbitrary terminal commands with Obsidian's permissions, and recommends vault backups. Metadata triggers, the MCP server, and the Obsidian-focused prompt are marked ALPHA.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to work with external AI agents that can read and modify vault files and execute shell commands under user approval.

relations.evidence: Claude Code is Anthropic's official CLI agent with excellent ACP support.
Critical backup when using auto-approve write permissions

requires.name: ACP-compatible agent (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Mistral)

summary: Agent Client Protocol client that lets AI coding agents like Claude Code chat with you, edit vault files, and run terminal commands.
